title: Royal British Columbia Museum
scope: Standing Royal BC Museum building complex on Belleville Street in Victoria, including the concrete Exhibition Building, Fannin curatorial tower, glass lobby and IMAX, and the low BC Archives wing.
limitations: Height bands use native roof samples and provincial engineering dimensions. Curtain wall panels, stone tones, stair widths and individual roof fixtures are approximate. The photograph-derived exterior features are matched to the building phase identified in the current operator records.

The scope includes the connected museum masses and the BC Archives wing at the entrance. The independently located carillon and historic precinct houses have their own identities. Interiors, exhibits, temporary signs and display pieces are outside the modeled exterior.
